title: Korean BBQ Chicken
summary: Gochujang-marinated thighs, charred under the broiler or on the grill. Sweet, hot, sticky.

ingredients.note: tenderizes and sweetens; skip if you don't have one

steps.title: Marinade
steps.text: Whisk the gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger and pear (if using) in a large bowl until smooth.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Add the chicken and turn to coat every piece. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, up to overnight. Pull it out 20 minutes before cooking.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Broiler: set a rack 6 inches from the element, line a sheet pan with foil, brush with the oil, and preheat on high for 5 minutes. Grill: medium-high, grates oiled.

steps.title: Cook side one
steps.text: Lay the thighs out flat without crowding. Broil or grill until deeply browned with charred edges, 6 to 7 minutes. The sugar will blacken in spots; that's the point.

steps.title: Cook side two
steps.text: Flip and cook until the thickest piece reads 165°F and the glaze is sticky, 5 to 6 minutes more.

steps.title: Rest and finish
steps.text: Rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips. Scatter with scallions and sesame seeds and spoon any pan juices over the top.

notes: Thighs forgive the high heat; breasts dry out before the glaze chars. Double the marinade and freeze half with raw chicken for a zero-effort weeknight.
